operations.before: | Low-value asset (GWG): expensed in full if cost net of deductible input VAT is not more than | EUR 800 | 2026 | https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__6.html |
operations.after: | Low-value asset (GWG): expensed in full if cost reduced by contained input VAT for the eligibility test is not more than | EUR 800 | 2026 | https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__6.html |

operations.before: - **The EUR 800 GWG test** uses cost less deductible input VAT only (§ 6(2) EStG: "vermindert um einen darin enthaltenen Vorsteuerbetrag"), so a Kleinunternehmer tests the gross price. Example: a chair at EUR 952 gross (EUR 800 plus 19% VAT, [§ 12(1) UStG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ustg_1980/__12.html)) is above EUR 800 for a Kleinunternehmer and must be depreciated or pooled; a business in the normal scheme records EUR 800 and expenses it in full.
operations.after: - **The EUR 800 GWG test** uses cost reduced by the input VAT contained in the price (§ 6(2) EStG: "vermindert um einen darin enthaltenen Vorsteuerbetrag"), including where it is not recoverable. Keep eligibility separate from the deductible expense: [§ 9b(1) EStG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__9b.html) excludes recoverable VAT from acquisition cost; irrecoverable VAT remains in cost. An otherwise eligible self-usable business chair at EUR 952 gross (EUR 800 plus 19% VAT, [§ 12(1) UStG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ustg_1980/__12.html)) meets the EUR 800 test in both cases. A Kleinunternehmer can choose to expense the full EUR 952; a business entitled to full input-VAT credit expenses EUR 800 and claims the EUR 152 VAT separately.
